metadata.description: Experience design and learning transfer skills from Andy Sontag, creator of the 5E Experience Design model.

plugins.name: 5e-experience-design
plugins.description: Design and pressure-test the emotional arc of a workshop, programme, event or onboarding using the 5E Experience Design model. Works from ambition down to moves, designs the feelings before the activities, and always ends in a 5E Experience Design Journey Map.
